method: Direct constant nodes and projection structure names. Named definitions are not unfolded.
selection: Five inspections of the same solution. The first requested 174 names, including all 155 route declarations, and found 171. The second added six declarations for comparison with compiled modules. The third requested 27 theta-related names and found 21, including one previously queried. The fourth scanned 62 candidate names and found 52 new declarations. Nine additional names were confirmed in the source and absent from the export. A namespace spelling candidate was excluded from the published source-name list. The fifth recovered all 27 additional branch names. The combined selection contains 276 distinct declarations and 18 confirmed source names absent from the export. Line numbers are one-based and byte offsets are zero-based in the unpacked solution. Three later inspections covered adelic lattice packing, transverse periods, arithmetic faces and the cohomological torsion comparison. The sixth requested 66 names and found 65. The seventh requested 42 and found 42. The eighth requested 9 and found 9. Across all eight inspections the combined selection contains 392 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The ninth inspection added all nine requested declarations for the degree shift in arithmetic face homology. The total is now 401 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The tenth inspection searched 77 new names for branching periods, local unfolding, compact-type compression and coefficient decay. It recovered 77 declarations. The combined total is 478 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The eleventh inspection searched 78 new names for unitary covolumes, parabolic shell measures, the mixed compact Casimir and shifted tensor moments. It recovered 77 declarations. The combined total is 555 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The twelfth inspection searched 47 new names for prescribed-discriminant lattice masses, exact unipotence from near traces, and previously identified private and slice-measure intermediates. It recovered 47 declarations. The combined total is 602 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The thirteenth inspection searched 48 new names for rational subspace orbits, the local genus of maximal Hermitian lattices, and derivatives of branching vectors. It recovered all 48 declarations. The combined total is 650 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The fourteenth inspection searched 28 new names for quantum cofactors, primitive discriminant gluings, and the orthonormal and derivative suppliers. It recovered all 28 declarations. The combined total is 678 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The fifteenth inspection searched 13 new names for short primitive lines, trace-lattice packing, and adjacent-column cancellation in a quantum minor. It recovered all 13 declarations. The combined total is 691 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The sixteenth inspection searched 24 new names for the branching walk, its large- and small-side lowering steps, and the occurrence model. It recovered all 24 declarations. The combined total is 715 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The seventeenth inspection searched 4 new names for the two coefficient-integral constructions of intertwiners and the stabilizer estimate in the global primitive mean. It recovered all 4 declarations. The combined total is 719 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The eighteenth inspection searched 8 new names for line projection labels and recovery of a hyperplane gluing from one lifted generator. It recovered all 8 declarations. The combined total is 727 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The nineteenth inspection queried 48 new names for the dual tensor construction, regular parameter models, coefficient integrals, line mass and the hyperplane average. It recovered 47 declarations. One candidate belongs to a different namespace in the source and is excluded from the source-only list. The combined selection contains 774 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source-only names. The twentieth inspection queried 37 new names for the smaller-parameter lowering, derivative words, the distant trial vector and its spectral estimate. It recovered 37 declarations. The combined selection contains 811 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source-only names. The twenty-first inspection queried 29 new names for the signed compression frame and the exclusion of singular translated poles. It recovered 29 declarations. The combined selection contains 840 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source-only names. The twenty-second inspection queried 36 new names for the character-line subtraction used in the geometric Galois construction, the local compatibility induction and its selected coefficient normalization. It recovered 34 declarations. The source theorem on unrestricted split-prime density is absent under its own name. The selected guarded-place argument takes the density of its designated places from a separate degree-one argument. One candidate belongs to a different namespace in the source and is excluded from the source-only list. The combined selection contains 874 distinct declarations and 20 confirmed source-only names. The twenty-third inspection queried 9 new names for the passage from good Frobenius classes to the comparison of even-rank representations at the guarded places. It recovered 9 declarations. The combined selection contains 883 distinct declarations and 20 confirmed source-only names. The twenty-fourth inspection queried 99 names for compact weight selection, the invariant Casimir cutoff, descent, and identification of the terminal type and recovered 93 declarations. Six source spellings are private. Their full export spellings are checked in the twenty-seventh selection. The twenty-fifth inspection queried 44 names for the two realizations of the terminal compact type and Frobenius on the permitted split places and recovered 44 declarations. The twenty-sixth inspection queried 40 names for orthogonality through the derivative layers, and the limiting construction and local properties of the odd-rank companion and recovered 40 declarations. The twenty-seventh inspection queried 6 names for the resolved module-qualified private constants used in the compact derivative and parameter calculations and recovered 6 declarations. The combined selection contains 1066 distinct declarations and 20 previously documented source-only names. The twenty-eighth inspection combined the derivative layer, positive tensor trace and geometric odd-rank seed in a single digest-checked scan. It recovered all 103 newly selected declarations, including the private opposite-sign counting lemma under its module-qualified name. The combined selection contains 1,169 distinct declarations and 20 previously documented source-only names. The twenty-ninth inspection traced the finite Hecke approximation, polynomial restriction and the holomorphic Lefschetz input. Both private approximation lemmas were queried under their module-qualified names. The 34 queries included two extra namespace candidates excluded after finding both declarations under their exact names. The scan recovered 32 newly selected declarations. The combined selection contains 1,201 distinct declarations and 20 previously documented source-only names. The thirtieth inspection followed the normalized ideal norm of a terminal minor through the product formula, the extended different and the height bound. The scan recovered 18 newly selected declarations. The combined selection contains 1,219 distinct declarations and 20 previously documented source-only names.
